Problem Statement:
G(x) = G(x-1) + 9, G(0) = 1. Given x, find G(x). x >= 1
Input Description:
Read a single integer x.
Output Description:
Print a single line, the value of G(x)
Explanation:
G(2) = G(1) + 9 = G(0) + 9 + 9 = 19
